market_definition: The thermally conductive adhesives market comprises liquid or paste adhesives filled with thermally conductive but electrically insulating fillers that bond components and dissipate heat. It measures sales of finished one- and two-component thermal bonding adhesives. BY CHEMISTRY: Epoxy, Silicone, Polyurethane, Acrylic & Other. BY FILLER TYPE: Alumina, Boron Nitride, Aluminium Nitride, Other Fillers. BY THERMAL CONDUCTIVITY: < 1 W/mK, 1–3 W/mK, > 3 W/mK. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Consumer Electronics, Automotive Electronics & EV Batteries, Industrial & Power Electronics, Telecom & Data Centers, Medical Devices, Aerospace & Defense, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Thermally conductive adhesive tapes; thermal greases, gap pads and fillers; electrically conductive adhesives. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
